answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 57 identities per epoch. Audits are logged in thread, queued in ocean, and sonnet publishes the wait time. A farm of 352 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3376 identities would post 903 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
